text:
ryan: Quick heads-up — prepping a POC load run for Orion Health tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need two things: a short sanity run (5–10m) and a longer stress window (30m). Target profile: ~800 qps sustained, 2k qps burst for <2m, model redwood-2.7b-q4, avg prompt 60 tokens, gen 120 tokens. Can eng reserve capacity + confirm a rough cost estimate? Also customer asked for an SLA slide and failover notes. cc @maya @sam

maya: I can own the runbook + slide. Do we need VPC/private deployment for this POC or is hosted OK? Any PIIs in prompts?

ryan: Hosted is fine for POC, no PHI. They will sign NDA if we need to switch later.

sam: Re capacity — recommend reserving a small dedicated pool for the 40m window, otherwise noise will make tail latency useless. For numbers you gave, 4x A100-ish equivalent should be safe with autoscale headroom. I’ll book capacity.

lia: For observability, capture token throughput, p50/p95/p99 latency, queue length, GPU util, and memory/kv-cache hits. Also export request IDs so we can correlate traces.

maya: Proposed ramp plan (short form):
1) 0–2m: warmup @100 qps (prefix/KV cache warm)
2) 2–7m: sanity ramp to 800 qps
3) 7–9m: 2k burst (30–90s) to simulate spike
4) 9–40m: steady 800 qps sustained
5) 40–45m: cool-down
Include randomized prompt lengths to match 60±10 tokens.

sam: Load generator snippet to use (we'll run from k8s test runner):
```bash
wrk -t12 -c200 -d30m -R800 --latency "http://redwood-test/prod/generate" \n  -s ./scripts/payload.lua \n  --header "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY"
```
Payload script will send mixed sequences; we’ll seed KV cache on warmup.

lia: Add this to runbook: collector endpoints, grafana dashboard links, and a small script to fetch p99 logs. Example p99 command: `curl $OBS_API/p99?run_id=$RUN`

perf-bot: Test environment created: env-id=orion-poc-2419056789, reserved 4 devices, start window=2419123200 (tomorrow 10:00am PT).

ryan: Awesome — cost question: can someone ballpark incremental run cost (GPU hours + tokens) for the 45m slot? Need a number to share with customer.

sam: Quick napkin math: 4 devices reserved for 1h (we book 1h min) ~ $600/hr (internal rate) = $2400. Tokens: approx qps*duration*(prompt+gen) = 800*2700s*180 tokens = ~388M tokens. With hosted token rate that’s ~$1164. Total rough = $3564 (I’ll send exact calc). Note: bursts increase compute but we have headroom in reservation.

maya: Acceptance criteria suggestion for the writeup: steady p95 < 200ms, p99 < 500ms, no >1% error rate, and sustained throughput within ±10% of target for the 30m window. If we fail, we include fallback notes (model variant fallback to smaller quantized variant).

ryan: Perfect. @sam can you attach the slide & runbook by EOD? I’ll share numbers with Orion and lock calendar.

sam: On it — will drop runbook + high-level SLA slide in the sales folder and tag this thread when done.

lia: I’ll add tracing snippets and the p99 extraction script to the runbook before handoff.

ryan: Thanks all, feel much better about tomorrow. :thumbsup:
